svg.title: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🪫 Builds that degrade into a known state / 💬 A commit that reads as prose / 🧮 Risk measured, not felt / 🧬 A result reproducible from one command / 📮 A release that arrives with a rollback / 🧱 Composed from parts that do one thing / 🎲 Generated nightly, nobody chose when / 🔬 Results that survive a new seed / 🛟 An escape hatch when it goes wrong / 🌱 No default ages into a mystery / 🔗 No dependency without a known licence / 🔐 Default to least access, always

g.text: 🪫 Builds that degrade into a known state
💬 A commit that reads as prose
🧬 A result reproducible from one command
📮 A release that arrives with a rollback
🧱 Composed from parts that do one thing
🔬 Results that survive a new seed
🛟 An escape hatch when it goes wrong
🌱 No default ages into a mystery
🔗 No dependency without a known licence
